scope: Own isolated project; real ADB touch drag/cancel, native filesystem and editor; WebView timings describe this fixture only

checks.test: Selecting a folder targets both creation dialogs to that folder
Selecting a file targets its containing folder
Clicking outside the explorer clears its selection without closing the file
Moving an open unsaved file preserves text, caret, breakpoints and local history
Conflicting destinations preserve both original files
Backend rejects moving a directory into its descendant
Moving a folder remaps nested open documents and their encodings
Actual Android touch drag handle moves a file to another folder
Releasing a drag outside the explorer cancels it safely
Alternating C++ and CMake tabs leaves native editing ready
Idle UI animation cadence stays responsive during the scenario
Report issue opens a prefilled GitHub draft, without posting
Actual Android long press opens file actions including Show in Files
Actual tap on empty explorer space clears selection
